reviews.title: Lumi!
reviews.text: I love this app. It is so helpful, because I want to know what is going on my skin, body, hair! I really appreciate what your doing. And thank you for keeping it mostly free!!

reviews.title: No more impulsive buying
reviews.text: I have fungal acne and perioral dermatitis. It has been difficult to find a single solution that can address both issues because their treatments are quite different. I have an enormous collection of many skincare products that have only made things worse. I stopped making impulsive purchases due to paid marketing after downloading "Lumi." I can now simply check triggers and ingredients on a single app. forever grateful!!
